children: Shell Offshore, a subsidiary of British oil and gas major Shell
, said on Wednesday it would acquire a 30% stake in the BP-operated
Conifer exploration prospect in the Gulf of Mexico.
BP said in a separate statement it will retain the remaining 50% interest in Tupinamba and 70% in Conifer and continue as operator in both.
